summary: Reads metadata from media files or linked Movie File In TOP and Audio File In CHOP operators, returning details such as codec, frame rate, sample rate, and resolution.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Media file path or URL to inspect

key_params.name: topchop
key_params.note: Optional Movie File In TOP or Audio File In CHOP source to inspect

key_params.name: opentimeout
key_params.note: Seconds to wait for media metadata to open

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: The source can be a file path or a linked TOP/CHOP, so avoid setting both ambiguously in generated patches.
Open timeout can produce no metadata until the file is reachable and parsed.
Transpose changes row and column orientation, which affects downstream table lookups.
Use this DAT for metadata only; it does not decode frames or samples for playback.
key_concepts: Reads metadata about a media file or media-producing TOP/CHOP.
The File parameter can inspect media paths directly while TOP/CHOP selects an operator source.
Reload Pulse forces metadata refresh and Open Timeout bounds file-open waits.
Transpose changes whether metadata fields are emitted by row or column.
